Diljit Dosanjh questions lyric bans, cites Coldplay

Singer Diljit Dosanjh has criticized what he perceives as double standards regarding song lyrics, particularly in the context of his music being subject to restrictions. During a concert in Ahmedabad, Dosanjh questioned why his lyrics face scrutiny while international artists like Coldplay are permitted to perform their songs without issue. He stated, 'When Coldplay sings nobody has a problem.'
